label: iPad Pro 12.9-inch (6th gen) tablet
description: Apple iPad Pro 12.9-inch (6th generation, M2) — 12.9-inch mini-LED tablet, Wi-Fi 6E and 5G sub-6/mmWave; Thunderbolt/USB 4 port with Ethernet support.
notes: Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax, 2x2, 2.4/5/6 GHz) — the only iPad here that uses 6 GHz. Cellular (optional SKU): 5G sub-6 GHz plus mmWave (US models), LTE fallback. Thunderbolt/USB 4 port also works as a 10GbE Ethernet host with an adapter (modelled as usb0 at 1G). Highest-throughput wireless client in this set; use it to exercise 6 GHz and 160 MHz channels.
